mapper.sql: id, email, display_name, avatar_url, google_subject, enabled, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email}) LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM auth_users WHERE google_subject = #{googleSubject} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_users (id, email, display_name, avatar_url, google_subject, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{displayName}, #{avatarUrl}, #{googleSubject}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
